title: The island where you can see tomorrow

story.headline: The island where you can *see tomorrow*

post.title: The island where you can see tomorrow 🕛
post.premise: Two islands you could row between, 21 hours apart on the calendar
post.bait: Would you live where tomorrow is across the water? 👇
post.description:
In the Bering Strait, two islands sit less than four kilometres apart. The International Date Line runs between them, so the one you can see across the water is almost a full day ahead. This map story draws the line, measures the gap, and shows who lives on each side.
Would you live where tomorrow is across the water? Tell us below.
